A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Plan-RewardBench work. Their complete main text, tables, figures, equations, and Appendices A–F support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original evaluator accuracies in Table 4, human-audit agreement in Table 2, and downstream BFCL v4 reranking results in Appendix D, Table 7.

after.justification: v2 retains the original benchmark evaluations, human-audit results, diagnostic analyses, and BFCL v4 reranking experiment.

M1.justification: The trajectory-generation, hard-negative construction, rubric scoring, meta-review, pair assembly, and post-check procedures remain unchanged. The appendix templates and scoring rubrics also match.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same Toucan/MCP-derived benchmark covering Safety Refusal, Tool-Irrelevance/Unavailability, Complex Planning, and Robust Error Recovery. The BFCL v4 downstream evaluation already appears in v1.

E2.justification: Table 4 retains the same six discriminative reward models, three generative reward models, and twelve LLM judges. Inf-ORM-Llama3.1-70B already appears in v1. Table 7 also retains the same reranking comparators and selection controls.

E3.justification: The dataset counts, seven evaluation splits, input representations, pairwise accuracy metric, macro-averaging, and A/B swap protocol are unchanged. Appendix D retains four-candidate reranking with the same Qwen3-32B-Instruct base agent.

E4.justification: The length-sensitivity analysis, Appendix B.2 turn-count analysis, four qualitative failure-mode analyses, and Appendix F examples are retained without substantive changes. No ablation or robustness analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Human-audit agreement reporting remains identical, including Cohen's kappa values of 0.86, 0.81, 0.75, and 0.71 in Table 2. Neither version adds different run-count disclosures, uncertainty estimates, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: The numerical results and qualitative findings match throughout, including Tables 4, 6, and 7 and Figures 3–4. For example, Qwen-Plus retains 69.96% benchmark average accuracy and 55.14 BFCL Overall, against the unchanged First@1 value of 48.71.

T1.justification: The formal task setup and Appendix E.1 definitions and cost expressions remain unchanged. No mathematical assumption, derivation, theorem, or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The benchmark, construction recipe, label-quality controls, and diagnostic contributions retain their scope. The revised abstract preserves the claims about evaluator weaknesses on long trajectories and the need for specialized reward modeling.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning context collapse, evaluator biases, scaling, and downstream applicability are unchanged. The limitations concerning subjective labels, proprietary API coverage, uneven scenario representation, and English text-only traces are also retained.

D1.justification: v1 promises code and data after corporate approval. v2 adds direct code/data links and reports public availability in Release and Reproducibility; Appendix B.1 now says exact prompt/config files are included. Other technical details and stated licenses remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works, related-work discussion, benchmark comparisons in Table 1, and research positioning remain unchanged, including citations in the appendices.

P1.justification: The abstract is tightened and rephrased, release statements are updated, and author footnote symbols change. Section ordering and nearly all main-text and appendix prose remain unchanged.

P2.justification: v2 adds a code/data link block with icons below the abstract and removes the pending-release footnote, causing minor text reflow. The numbered figures and tables retain their content and display structure.

improvement.justification: v2 improves documented access and usability by replacing a conditional release promise with specific code/data links and reported availability of prompts/configs. The tighter abstract provides a small clarity gain. Scientific evidence and limitations remain unchanged; the PDFs alone do not verify the linked artifacts.
